variant_decisions.evidence: The variant is orthographic: ketiv וקריתמה lacks the yod of qere וְקִרְיָתָֽיְמָה, and both spell the same place name, which ASV gives in its conventional English form 'Kiriathaim'. A transliterated proper name does not distinguish plene from defective spelling, and the only note on the verse is classed alternative_rendering ('Or, in every quarter'), which concerns the English of the frontiers clause and cannot decide a reading. Base fallback (qere) carries the projection.
